name: code-guard
description: Harness and loops for Claude Code: hooks that stop dangerous operations (push to protected branches, secret reads, destructive commands), plus a verify loop, a review loop and a docs check.

protected_branches.title: Protected branches
protected_branches.description: Branches that git push is blocked for

confirm_push.title: Confirm pushes
confirm_push.description: Ask for confirmation before pushing a work branch

pack_github.title: GitHub pack
pack_github.description: Guard gh secret / repo delete / pr merge / api mutations

pack_terraform.title: Terraform pack
pack_terraform.description: Guard terraform destroy / apply / state and format edited files

pack_gcp.title: GCP pack
pack_gcp.description: Guard gcloud / gsutil deletes and secret value reads

pack_cloudflare.title: Cloudflare pack
pack_cloudflare.description: Guard wrangler deploy / delete / secret changes

doc_check_before_pr.title: Docs check before a PR
doc_check_before_pr.description: Block gh pr create until /code-guard:doc-code-consistency has checked the branch head

verify_max_retry.title: Verify retries
verify_max_retry.description: How many times the verify loop sends a failure back to Claude in one turn (1-10)
